text.p: Caterpillar Inc said Wednesday it planned to split its stock on a two-for-one basis in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend.
The stock dividend is payable July 11 to shareholders of record June 23, Caterpillar said.
Earlier, Caterpillar said its board voted to increase the company's quarterly cash dividend by 25 percent to $0.50 a share.
The cash dividend is on a pre-split basis.

"We've set record sales and profits for the last three years and instituted the strategies that will continue to make us a leading global competitor well into the next century," said Caterpillar Chairman and Chief Executive Donald Fites.
"These actions further demonstrate our board's confidence in the company's ability to maintain superior performance in the years ahead," he added.
At the end of the first quarter, Caterpillar had 189.5 million shares outstanding.
